metaDescription: NIKKE SR Collection Item Enhancement Planner: recommend a Maintenance Kit strategy and estimate the average kit use needed to reach a target Phase.
pageTitle: NIKKE SR Collection Item Enhancement Planner
heroCopy: Enter the current Phase, EXP, and Maintenance Kit inventory to get a recommended strategy and estimated average kit use. Record each actual result to update the plan.
noticeEmphasis: Results are probability-based estimates, not fixed costs.
noticeDetail: Super Success is random. Record each enhancement result and recalculate before the next attempt.
inventoryCopy: Enter your Maintenance Kit inventory. Each enhancement consumes {actionSize} kits of the same rarity.
capacityWaiting: Awaiting calculation. Results are probability-based estimates for the available inventory and may be fractional.
recommendWaiting: Enter inventory to generate a recommendation.
consumptionHeading: Estimated Average Kit Use per Target Completion
consumptionCopy: Based on the optimal strategy for current inventory; decimals represent long-run averages.
recordCopy: Select the Maintenance Kit used and record the actual result. Inventory and Phase update automatically.
policyCopy: Based on current inventory. Follow the recommendation above and recalculate after every enhancement.
methodScopeText: Uses the current Phase, EXP, and available inventory to estimate kit use and completion capacity for strategies combining R, SR, and SSR Maintenance Kits.
methodMeaningText: A circle marks a primary choice, a triangle marks a secondary option in a mixed strategy, and a cross marks a kit that is not recommended under current conditions.
methodExecutionText: Each enhancement consumes {actionSize} kits of the same rarity. Record the actual result and recalculate before the next attempt; do not follow a static table across multiple attempts.
footerDisclaimer: Unofficial fan tool | Local calculation; inventory data is never uploaded | Probability-based estimates for planning only
strategyError: No valid strategy could be generated from the current inventory.
capacityAchievedNote: The current Phase has already reached the selected target (Phase {target}).
adjustTarget: Adjust the target Phase or current state.
capacityEnough: Available inventory is estimated to reach the target {whole} times. Recalculate after each actual result.
capacityInsufficient: Available inventory is not expected to reach the target once. The estimated shortage for the displayed strategy is shown below.
addUsableGroup: Add at least {actionSize} usable Maintenance Kits of the same rarity.
consumptionRemaining: Estimated use: {used} kits | Estimated remaining after target: {remaining} kits
consumptionShortage: Estimated use: {used} kits | Estimated shortage: about {shortage} kits
wholeAchieved: Full target completions: Target already reached
shortagePrefix: Estimated shortage to reach the target once with the current strategy:
shortageSuffix: . This is a probability-based average; allow extra kits for random variation.
notEnoughToRecord: Fewer than {actionSize} usable {material} kits remain after reserves, so this enhancement cannot be recorded.
alreadyAtTarget: The current Phase has reached the selected target. Adjust the target Phase or current state.
inputsChanged: Inputs changed. Recalculate to update the plan.
printUnavailable: The plan is not ready. Recalculate and print again.
printWarning: No complete, up-to-date plan is available. Return to the page and calculate before printing.
convergenceError: The solver could not verify an optimal strategy. No unverified plan is shown.
storageRecovered: Some saved data could not be restored. Please check your inventory and current state.
